title: Initiative
description: Optional container: one outcome across several Epics. Aliases: Theme, Program.

status.description: Optional: `done` or `cancelled` when a person closes or stops it; draft and active are derived from the children.

proposal.description: The accepted proposal this Initiative delivers, so every change under it traces back to what was promised.

go_no_go.description: Optional: a person's decision to pursue the Initiative or not, in the proposal's shape (`decision`, `by`, `on`, `reason`). Only a person records it; an agent never fills it, and `aidd validate` fails on an agent in `by`. `no_go` derives the status `cancelled`.

milestones.description: The delivery milestones and their invoicing hooks, copied from the accepted proposal by `aidd proposal convert`: from then on the Initiative is the delivery record, and the delivery manager keeps it current.

risks.description: The R of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

assumptions.description: The A of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

issues.description: The I of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

dependencies.description: The D of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

decisions.description: The scope decisions log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here. A person records each entry.
